description: Turn the investigation into a report, save it and hand off the next session.

identity.goal: Complete the write report use case of craft-anything using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the craft-anything upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `craftanything` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced craftanything_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `craftanything_core_report_write`, `craftanything_core_report_save`, `craftanything_core_handoff_write`. Steps: (1) Generate the report from the brief, plan, findings and hypotheses. (2) Save it in the requested format. (3) {'Rewrite the handoff note': 'where we are, what is next, the traps.'} Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace craftanything was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
